# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "chernigov_and_novgorod_seversk_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}

last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- gsub("\u2116", "No.", clean_vec)
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) return("-")
  out <- paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; ")
  if (nchar(out) > 48L) out <- paste0(substr(out, 1L, 45L), "...")
  return(out)
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  fmt_deg <- function (val) {
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(val)))
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(s)
  }
  lat_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lat), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lon), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  ord <- order(yrs)
  yrs <- yrs[ord]
  vals <- vals[ord]
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  if (length(keep) > 5L) {
    sel_idx <- unique(round(seq(1, length(keep), length.out = 5L)))
    keep <- keep[sel_idx]
  }
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles population estimates for `r format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")` excavated settlements across the 72,24k km² Southern Core of the Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk lands (modern Chernihiv and Sumy provinces and the lower Sozh corridor around Gomel) from the Upper Palaeolithic (10000BC) to 1400AD [@kovalenko2008chernihiv; @morgunov2003posemye; @kuza1989malye]. Early entries trace the mammoth-hunter winter camps of the middle Desna gorge (Mezin and Pushkari I, 75 - 120 inhabitants in 10000BC), the Early Iron Age promontory forts of the Yukhnovo and Milograd cultures (380 - 780 inhabitants in 500BC) and the tenth-century Varangian-Rus retinue bases at Shestovytsia (3,2k in 1000AD), Lyubech (3,5k) and Boldyni Hory (2,5k).

Under the Olgovichi dynasty in 1200AD, the urban network reached 120 fortified towns (*gorodishcha*), headed by the 330 ha capital at Chernigov (35k), the Seversk seats of Novgorod-Seversk (12k) and Putivl (7,5k), and the river towns of Gomel (6,5k), Snowsk (5k), Kursk (8k in the northern forest-steppe), Hlukhiv (4,5k) and Starodub (4,5k). Following Möngke and Batu's October 1239AD campaign across the Desna and Seym valleys, 68% of the southern frontier forts were abandoned; Chernigov fell to 4k in 1250AD (recovering to 6k by 1400AD), while princely authority shifted into the wooded refuges of Hlukhiv (4,5k in 1300AD) and Bryansk.

# Methodology

## Overview of the Settlement Gazetteer

Across the 72,24k km² Southern Core of the Chernigov-Seversk lands (Chernihivska Oblast, Sumska Oblast and the Eastern Gomel and Lower Sozh corridor), archaeological surveys and Rus chronicles document `r format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")` major settlements between 10000BC and 1400AD. These range from the Upper Palaeolithic mammoth-bone camps of the middle Desna gorge and the Early Iron Age promontory forts of the Yukhnovo and Milograd cultures to tenth-century Varangian-Rus retinue bases and the fortified *gorodishcha* of the Olgovichi principalities prior to and after the Mongol sack of October 1239. Each entry in the tables below gives the settlement's historical name, geographic coordinates (50,14°N - 53,13°N, 29,83°E - 35,26°E) and estimated population across the benchmark dates.

## Population Estimation from Archaeological Evidence

For the Upper Palaeolithic to Early Iron Age (10000BC - 500AD, 22 sites), mammoth-hunter winter camps on the middle Desna (Mezin, Pushkari I, Chulatovo I-II, Novgorod-Seversky and Buzhany) are reckoned at 75 - 120 persons per camp [@shovkoplyas1965mezinskaya; @boriskovsky1953paleolit; @velichko1997mammoth]. Yukhnovo and Milograd Early Iron Age hillforts (0,5 - 3 ha) are estimated at 380 - 780 inhabitants [@tretyakov1966finno], while Late Zarubintsy, Kiev culture (Roishche and Harivka-Desna) and Kolochin (Kolochin I) riverside villages are estimated at 580 - 850 inhabitants [@byrnya1991ranneslavyanskie; @symonovich1983chernyakhov].

For the Volyntsevo, Romny-Severian and Viking-Age centres (700AD - 1000AD), major Severian and Radimichi hillforts (Volyntsevo, Bytytsia, Gornal, Novotroitske and Romny) and Varangian-Rus garrison towns (Shestovytsia at 3,2k, Boldyni Hory at 2,5k, Mokhov at 1,95k and Lyubech at 3,5k) are estimated from excavated house counts (*poluzemlyanki*) and barrow cemeteries [@sukhobokov1975slaviane; @motsia2011shestovytsia; @androschuk2013vikings].

For the Olgovichi principalities at their twelfth- and early thirteenth-century peak (1050AD - 1239AD), walled *detinets* and *okolny gorod* ramparts (120 - 150 inh/ha) and outer *posad* and *podol* craft suburbs (75 - 100 inh/ha) follow the archaeological surveys of V. P. Kovalenko [@kovalenko2008chernihiv], A. V. Kuza [@kuza1989malye; @kuza1996gorodishcha], P. P. Tolochko [@tolochko1989goroda], A. K. Zaitsev [@zaitsev1975chernigov], Yu. Yu. Morgunov [@morgunov2003posemye] and H. V. Shtykhov [@shtykhov1992goroda]. For the October 1239AD Mongol sack and the post-conquest principalities (1250AD - 1300AD), estimates reflect excavated destruction layers across the Posemye and Desna valleys (Putivl, Vyr, Vorgol, Vsevolozh and Chernigov) and the survival of Hlukhiv (4,5k in 1300AD), Novgorod-Seversk (4,5k), Putivl (3,8k), Gomel (3,4k) and Chernigov (6k) [@dimnik2003olgovichi; @kuczynski1936ziemie].

# Results

## Summary by Chronological Horizon

```{r tab-epoch-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cnt_prehist <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) <= -1000, logical(1)))
cnt_classic <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > -1000 && first_year_num(s) <= 400, logical(1)))
cnt_med     <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 && first_year_num(s) <= 1240, logical(1)))
cnt_late    <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 1240 && first_year_num(s) <= 1400, logical(1)))

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Horizon = c(
    "I. Palaeolithic, Neolithic, Trypillia and Bronze Age (10000BC - 1000BC)",
    "II. Early Iron Age, Scythian, Roman-Era and Antiquity (999BC - 400AD)",
    "III. Early Slavonic and Pre-Mongol Kievan Rus (401AD - 1240AD)",
    "IV. Post-Mongol Appanage and Early Lithuanian Transition (1241AD - 1400AD)",
    "Total Gazetteer Settlements"
  ),
  First_Attested_Count = c(
    format(cnt_prehist, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_classic, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_med, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_late, big.mark = "."),
    format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  summary_df,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Chronological distribution of the ", format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = "."), " catalogued settlements and archaeological habitation sites in ", "Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk", " by horizon of earliest documented stratum (10000BC - 1400AD)."),
    col_names = c("Chronological Horizon", "Attested Sites"),
    label = "tab:epoch-summary",
    font_size = "footnotesize"
  )
)
```

## Prehistoric, Classical and Early Slavonic Habitation Sites

Table \ref{tab:prehistoric-classical} lists all `r format(sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 400, logical(1))), big.mark = ".")` settlements and excavated habitation sites first attested between 10000BC and 400AD, giving geographic coordinates, occupied spans and up to five representative benchmark population estimates.

```{r table-prehistoric-classical, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sub_ancient <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 400, settlements_list)
df_ancient <- data.frame(
  col_1 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  col_2 = vapply(sub_ancient, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  col_3 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  col_4 = vapply(sub_ancient, fmt_span, character(1)),
  col_5 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_ancient,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Prehistoric, Eneolithic, Bronze Age, Iron Age and Roman-era settlements founded between 10000BC and 400AD in ", "Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk", " (", format(length(sub_ancient), big.mark = "."), " entries)."),
    label = "tab:prehistoric-classical",
    col_names = c("Settlement / Site", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Span", "Selected Benchmarks"),
    font_size = "footnotesize",
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Medieval Rus, Appanage and Fourteenth-Century Centres

Table \ref{tab:medieval-towns} lists all `r format(sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 || last_year_num(s) >= 500, logical(1))), big.mark = ".")` settlements active between 500AD and 1400AD, pairing archaeological hillforts and fortified principality capitals with post-1240AD continuation toward the fifteenth century.

```{r table-medieval-towns, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sub_med <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 || last_year_num(s) >= 500, settlements_list)
df_med <- data.frame(
  col_1 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  col_2 = vapply(sub_med, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  col_3 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  col_4 = vapply(sub_med, fmt_span, character(1)),
  col_5 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, 401, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Medieval Rus, Golden Horde and Grand Duchy of Lithuania transition settlements active from 500AD to 1400AD in ", "Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk", " (", format(length(sub_med), big.mark = "."), " entries)."),
    label = "tab:medieval-towns",
    col_names = c("Settlement / Site", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Span", "Selected Benchmarks"),
    font_size = "footnotesize",
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```
